name: Princess Princess ~Shimaihime Haitoku no Gishiki~
original_name: プリンセス・プリンセス～姉妹姫背徳の儀式～
source:
Since Letitia, who governs her country called "Prismar", is a legendary heroine who has an outstanding talent for both politics and battles, all countries around are afraid of her...

But she has a weakness. Yes, she is a woman. There is a secret job called "sniper". Once they use their special techniques, every girl will show...

One day, someone decides to send the snipers to Prismar...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
由于统治着名为“棱镜”的国家的莉蒂西亚是一位在政治和战斗方面都具有杰出才能的传奇女英雄，周围的国家都对她感到畏惧……

但她有一个弱点。是的，她是一个女人。有一种秘密职业叫“狙击手”。一旦她们使用她们的特殊技巧，每个女孩都会表现出……

有一天，有人决定派狙击手前往普里斯玛……

[来自工口游戏商店]
